description: Partial upsert one menu item: send only the fields to change; omitted fields keep their stored value and parent: null moves it to the top level. data/attrs merge per key (data: {desc} keeps data.icon; a null value removes that key). A new id needs label, kind and ref (parent defaults to null, sort to the end) and dedupes by (menu, ref) onto an item linking the same target. An existing id updates that exact item. Remove html/childTemplate via put_menu_doc.
name: put_menu_item
